These records prove the BL1 assertions for the shipped blocks at this source revision. They do not set a milestone status; that is tracker state outside the repository.
The independent review is a read of the block sources and rules at the reviewed revision, advisory input to the human acceptance, and not a legal clearance of any brand, likeness, or license.

A review is reused for a block whose key (its tree, its participants' component records, and the React runtime sources) is unchanged since the reviewer read it. The reviewer judged the block against the content rules as they stood at its own reviewed revision; the content scan and the content-rule tests ran again at this capture.
